# Radoslav Radev Requires Minimum 10 Seconds on Straddle Front Lever Before Advancing to Full Front Lever

Radoslav Radev requires that before going from straddle front lever to full front lever, you have at least 10 seconds clean straddle front lever. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:10]

## Details

- If you want to go from straddle front lever to full front lever, make sure that you have at least 10 seconds clean straddle front lever, and then you can go to the mini straddle or directly to the full. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:10]

## Evidence

- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:10 (Radoslav Radev): "if you want to go from straddle front lever to full front lever, make sure that you have at least 10 seconds clean straddle front lever, and then you can go to the mini straddle or directly to the full."
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:40 (Radoslav Radev): "If you can't control the easier progression, you have no business going the harder one this is also how the people get hurt"

## Why This Matters

He says that skipping levels and not controlling the basics is how people get hurt. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:40]

## Connected Ideas

- [[Radoslav Radev Requires Minimum 10 Seconds on Tuck Planche Before Advancing to Advanced Planche]] — the same 10-second benchmark applied to planche progression.
